title: SkeneGraph-Net: Network analysis for TEI/XML-encoded drama

creators.name: Chronopoulos, Stylianos
creators.affiliation: University of Ioannina, Department of Philology

description: SkeneGraph-Net is a network-analysis application for TEI/XML-encoded drama, modelled on the DraCor API and departing from it on four methodological axes. (1) Three segmentation methods — stage directions (a new segment after every stage-direction element), div3 (the scene level), and div2 (the act / macro-structure level) — instead of DraCor's single scene-based segmentation. (2) Three network models spanning two orthogonal axes: the cast filter (whether play-level mute characters are admitted as nodes) and the edge rule (co-presence on stage versus co-speech within a segment), yielding stage co-presence, dialogic cast at play level, and dialogic cast at segment level. (3) Optional aggregation of collective figures — the chorus and its subdivisions — into a single node, or their treatment as distinct nodes. (4) A per-segment dynamic graph, exported as a Gephi-renderable GEXF with temporal spells, alongside the static aggregate. Each methodological choice is exposed explicitly in the accompanying dashboards to support data-assisted — rather than data-driven — philological reading.
